summary: Brothers in Arms entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Brothers in Arms: Road to Hill 30
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with compatibility fixes documented

emulation.notes: Use native PC route; PCSX2/Dolphin only for console comparison.

primary.version: Current Steam/GOG PC release with fixes documented
primary.why: The PC version is the best capture/settings route for Road to Hill 30, while the console versions are valid historical routes. Because it is an older Unreal-era PC release, compatibility fixes and widescreen/controller choices should be logged.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam or GOG PC release. Record storefront/build, OS, compatibility fixes, resolution/widescreen state, controller or mouse/keyboard, difficulty, and whether console versions were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting console controls/performance.
secondary.why: PC is the stronger archive capture route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record storefront/build, widescreen fix state, input method, and difficulty.

entries.title: Brothers in Arms: Hell's Highway
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with fixes/settings documented

emulation.notes: Use native PC route; emulate consoles only for comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current Windows PC build with documented settings

primary.why: The PC version is the highest-fidelity capture route for Hell's Highway, with modern resolution and input/fix options. PS3 and Xbox 360 remain useful launch-console references, but they do not add unique story content over the PC route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release. Record storefront, build/date, resolution, FOV/widescreen fix state, controller or mouse/keyboard, difficulty, multiplayer/service state, and whether PS3/Xbox 360 were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting console performance, controls, or multiplayer history.
secondary.why: PC is the best archive capture route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record widescreen/FOV and compatibility fixes, and note multiplayer/service state if tested.
